description: I am grateful to the people of the 7th District for re-electing me to represent them in Springfield, and I am pleased to announce that I have secured the votes of my colleagues to continue to serve as Speaker of the House. I am honored by the trust my community and colleagues have placed in me.
paid_for_by: Paid for by The People for Emanuel “Chris” Welch
title: Welch Secures Votes for Third Term as House Speaker — VoteChrisWelch.com
